name: ducktutor
description: A Socratic AI pair tutor with relevant web research and learning-gated, manually approved scoped edits.

interface.shortDescription: Understand and own every AI-assisted change
interface.longDescription: Explore code and relevant sources, reason about the smallest adequate solution, engage with the explanation, then optionally approve tightly scoped edits in a later request and prove understanding through diff review and adaptive questions.
defaultPrompt: Teach me how this codebase works without changing files.
Explain this issue and guide me through a minimal fix.
First guide me through this feature, then implement it only after I engage with the explanation.
Review my diff and quiz me on the changes.
